summary.text: LEDE AS (979 422 679), a private limited company, is an active entity in Enhetsregisteret; founded 1997-11-21; address Floodeløkka 1, 3915 PORSGRUNN, Norge. Main industry is Distribution of electricity (35.140); 430 registered employees; 4 registered sub-unit(s). Daily manager: Tom Rune Bjørtuft; Board chair: Øystein Disch Olsrød; Auditor: PRICEWATERHOUSECOOPERS AS. Accounts for 2025 (period ending 2025-12-31): revenue NOK 2.27 bn, operating profit NOK 572.09 m, net profit NOK 286.95 m, equity NOK 3.76 bn, total assets NOK 9.42 bn.
